subject: 🚨 Major Event Alert: Equal1 raises $60M Series B — Irish CMOS quantum company
body:
## Major Event Alert — Equal1 Raises $60M Series B

**Date:** January 15, 2026
**Company:** Equal1 (Dublin, Ireland)
**Event:** $60M (~€57M) Series B funding round

---

### Why This Matters

Equal1 has raised one of the largest single rounds ever for a European quantum hardware company. The funding brings total raised to **$85M** and validates silicon CMOS as a scalable path to commercial quantum computers.

**Key facts:**
- Equal1 builds silicon spin qubit processors fabricated at **TSMC** using standard CMOS processes
- Their **Bell-1 quantum server** integrates qubits, cryo-control electronics, and classical compute in a standard rack unit at 0.3 K
- Bell-1 is **already shipping** — the European Space Agency (ESA) is a confirmed customer
- Founded 2018 as a spinout from University College Dublin
- €13.7M DTIF (Irish government) grant received October 2025

**Sources:**
- SiliconAngle: https://siliconangle.com/2026/01/15/irish-startup-equal1-receives-60m-start-deploying-scalable-quantum-computing-tech/
- EU Startups: https://www.eu-startups.com/2026/01/irish-quantum-semiconductor-startup-equal1-closes-e51-million-round-to-scale-silicon-based-quantum-computing/

subject: 🚨 Major Event Alert: Groove Quantum raises €10M EIC — germanium qubit spinout of QuTech
body:
## Major Event Alert — Groove Quantum Raises €10M EIC Accelerator

**Date:** July 2025
**Company:** Groove Quantum (Delft, Netherlands)
**Event:** €10M EIC Accelerator award (grant + equity)

---

### Why This Matters

Groove Quantum is a 2024 spinout from QuTech developing germanium-based spin qubits. Germanium achieves higher operating temperatures and integrates natively with standard semiconductor manufacturing.

**Key facts:**
- Founded 2024 from QuTech (TU Delft / TNO)
- Technology: germanium spin qubits compatible with standard semiconductor fabs
- €10M EIC Accelerator — one of the largest early-stage EIC grants for quantum hardware
- Joins Q*Bird, FrostByte, Delft Circuits as QuTech spinouts in the directory

**Source:**
- The Quantum Insider: https://thequantuminsider.com/2025/07/07/groove-quantum-secures-e10-million-to-scale-germanium-based-quantum-chips/
